quantity: squared_leakage = r^dagger S r / (v^dagger S v), r=(I-P)v
units: dimensionless squared S-norm fraction, not amplitude or energy
shapes: S: nonempty (n,n); B: (n,k), k>=1; v: (n,) only; no column/batch aggregation
input_type: Finite real or complex numeric arrays; conjugate transposes are used
metric_requirements: Existing example metric check: Hermitian absolute Frobenius residual <=1e-12 and minimum eigenvalue >1e-10; these are example checks, not production gates
rank_convention: SVD of Cholesky-whitened, individually component-scaled B columns; retain singular values strictly above relative cutoff times largest; zero columns allowed; zero subspace has rank 0
zero_and_unreliable_input: Exactly zero vector is undefined and refused. Rescale nonzero finite v by its largest real/imaginary component before forming norms; refuse nonfinite/underflowed whitened norms or unsupported metric condition instead of returning zero
scale_handling: Scale S by its largest component and each nonzero B column and v by their own largest component; the resulting ratio is unchanged mathematically. No raw residual squared norm is returned under the ratio field
roundoff_handling: Refuse outside [-tol,1+tol]; clip only roundoff-sized excursions to [0,1]
